facts.fact: Malawi24 reports the National Local Government Finance Committee saying Malawi has had one ICT policy for the nation, the 'National Digitalization Policy', described as addressing country-wide ICT challenges and priorities, with the Policy 'of 2023'; its source verb is 'establishment of the Policy', no adopting act or approving body is named, and the value 'announced' is used only because no act is on record in this document.

systems.owner: Ministry of Information and Communications Technology (policy custodian)
systems.tiers: national; described only as addressing country-wide ICT challenges and priorities

systems.system: Local Authorities ICT policy and ICT standards
systems.owner: National Local Government Finance Committee and Department of E-Government
systems.tiers: local councils; validation sessions held 4 May 2026; aligned with the 2023 Digitalization policy

note: Scope of the National Digitalization Policy is not described beyond 'country-wide ICT challenges and priorities', so class is left empty.
